messages.body: Hi! Is the RAM 1500 still available?
Hello Alex, this is Carmexio CDMX. Yes, it is available and verified.
Great. Has it had any accidents?
No accidents. You can see the full inspection report in the app.
Can I see it this weekend?
Saturday at 11:00 works. See you at the CDMX showroom!
Hi, is the price of the Tucson negotiable?
The owner accepts $600,000 if you close this week.
We received your Mazda 3. Please bring it to our CDMX showroom for the inspection.
Your Mazda 3 passed verification and is now live.
